trigger_condition: representative_feature_status is PRIMARY_REPRESENTATIVE_FEATURES_AVAILABLE_PARTIAL or PRIMARY_REPRESENTATIVE_FEATURES_AVAILABLE_FULL and zero_fallback_true_count equals 0
allowed_downstream_use: May be used as weather context evidence for observed variables only.
blocked_downstream_use: Must not compute THCI final radar final hiking risk or medical diagnosis solely from this gate.
reason: Observed variables may be consumed as context but not as final score.

allowed_downstream_use: May preserve unavailable weather status for audit and explanation.
blocked_downstream_use: Must not score weather-sensitive activity features or treat absence as benign weather.
reason: No primary representative rows means weather evidence unavailable not normal.

allowed_downstream_use: May preserve missing evidence and QA status.
blocked_downstream_use: Must not score or infer normal weather from all-missing rows.
reason: All primary rows missing must block scoring.

allowed_downstream_use: May emit QA failure and block downstream consumption.
blocked_downstream_use: Must not consume any weather-derived score or context from the failed layer.
reason: Missing-to-zero fallback invalidates weather context consumption.

trigger_condition: available_weather_variable_set is non-empty and missing_weather_variable_set is non-empty and zero_fallback_true_count equals 0
allowed_downstream_use: May consume only observed variables listed in available_weather_variable_set.
blocked_downstream_use: Must not consume missing variables or fill missing values.
reason: Partial features are valid only for observed variables.

trigger_condition: context output has proxy-only status or NOT_OBSERVED_PROXY_ONLY time_effect_type and zero_fallback_true_count equals 0
allowed_downstream_use: May use as review-only contextual evidence with explicit direct-observation boundary.
blocked_downstream_use: Must not claim direct observation or final risk from proxy-only context.
reason: Proxy-only context needs explicit claim boundary.

trigger_condition: output claims direct WBGT UV sunshine visibility weather text gust short-duration rain heat illness THCI or final risk without supported source
allowed_downstream_use: May keep record for QA failure and documentation.
blocked_downstream_use: Must not publish or consume direct unsupported claim.
reason: Unsupported direct claim must block downstream use.

allowed_downstream_use: May use as preceding weather background or support for conservative delayed-effect proxy review.
blocked_downstream_use: Must not directly claim current rain wet trail soil moisture stream surge or slope instability.
reason: Antecedent rain is lookback context not direct current condition.

allowed_downstream_use: May use as review-only delayed-response context.
blocked_downstream_use: Must not claim direct wet trail soil moisture stream surge slope instability or unsafe crossing without direct evidence.
reason: Delayed response proxy is not direct observation.

allowed_downstream_use: May use only as proxy or review-only evidence.
blocked_downstream_use: Must not claim actual fog low visibility or observed weather text.
reason: Direct target is unavailable in current DB.

trigger_condition: downstream asks for THCI radar final hiking risk or medical diagnosis from IB3W context alone
allowed_downstream_use: May pass context to a separate validated downstream model only after gate acceptance.
blocked_downstream_use: Must not directly output final score from IB3W context layer alone.
reason: IB3W is context evidence not final scoring.
